title: Machines Racing the Clock
statement:
A factory has `m` machines working at the same time. Machine `i` finishes one product every `t_i` seconds: the first at second `t_i`, the next at `2 * t_i`, and so on. Find the smallest number of seconds after which the machines together have finished at least `P` products.

## Input
The first line contains `m` and `P`. The second line contains `m` integers `t_i`.

## Output
Print the smallest number of seconds `T` such that the total of `floor(T / t_i)` over all machines is at least `P`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= m <= 100000`
- `1 <= P <= 10^9`
- `1 <= t_i <= 10^9`
